aaa_enabled.summary: Enable the AAA subsystem on Arista EOS, then define authentication methods.
aaa_enabled.notes: Enabling AAA changes login behaviour immediately. Configure local fallback authentication to avoid lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Restrict VTY line transport input to SSH.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Ensure no plaintext administrative access is permitted.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set VTY session idle timeout to 10 minutes or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Timeout must be non-zero to tear down inactive sessions.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure a secure enable secret password.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Always use enable secret instead of enable password.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default public and private SNMP community strings.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Replace with a strong community name.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable administrative http/https access if not required, or disable unencrypted HTTP.
http_server_disabled.notes: Disable unencrypted API access to protect credentials.

ssh_version_2.notes: Arista EOS defaults to SSH version 2.

logging_enabled.summary: Enable remote logging and sized local buffers.

management_acl.summary: Apply access-class to restrict administrative access to authorized subnets.

cli: Authorized Access Only. Activity is logged.
login_banner.notes: Ensure warning is displayed before access is granted.

password_min_length.summary: Configure minimum password length for local accounts.
password_min_length.notes: Ensures minimal complexity on local logins.

ntp_configured.notes: Use time synchronization for accurate audit logs.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Only read-only communities should be configured.
